💡 FlopperZiro | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: A low-cost, DIY, open-source hardware multi-tool for learning and experimenting with various wireless communication protocols and hardware interfaces.
✨ Key Features: • BadUSB (Rubber Ducky script execution) • RFID / NFC (Passive scanning and target emulation) • Infrared (IR) (Signal capture, replay, and SD persistence) • Sub-1 GHz (RF) (433 MHz signal capture, replay, and SD persistence) • Storage (Dynamic save and load functionality via MicroSD)
📖 Summary: FlopperZiro is an open-source, DIY, and cost-effective multi-tool inspired by the Flipper Zero, built on the Arduino IDE. It enables exploration of hardware protocols and wireless communication for electronics enthusiasts and hobbyists.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 skill-forge | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To streamline and standardize the development of AI agent skills, making them production-ready and easily shareable across different platforms.
✨ Key Features: • Plan skill architecture and complexity tiers • Scaffold complete skill file trees • Audit skills with a health score • Evolve skills based on feedback • Publish skills as .skill files
📖 Summary: Skill Forge is a comprehensive Python-based tool for designing, building, reviewing, evolving, and publishing production-grade AI agent skills that adhere to the Agent Skills open standard. It automates the entire skill development lifecycle, from initial planning and scaffolding to conversion for other platforms and performance benchmarking.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 whisperbot | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a seamless way to transcribe voice messages sent to a Telegram bot into text.
✨ Key Features: • Transcribes audio messages via Telegram • Supports whisper.cpp and qwen-asr backends • Handles audio downloading and conversion (WAV) • Streams transcription results back to Telegram • Manages ASR processing queue with a mutex and atomic counter
📖 Summary: Whisperbot is a Telegram bot written in C that transcribes audio messages into text using either whisper.cpp or qwen-asr as the backend. It handles audio conversion, transcription processing, and streams the results back to the user, with options for managing queue length and switching between faster or higher-quality models.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 FireRedVAD | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Accurate and efficient detection of voice and audio events in multilingual audio streams for industrial applications.
✨ Key Features: • State-of-the-art Voice Activity Detection (VAD) • State-of-the-art Audio Event Detection (AED) • Supports non-streaming/streaming VAD • Supports non-streaming AED • Speech/singing/music detection
📖 Summary: FireRedVAD is a state-of-the-art library for Voice Activity Detection (VAD) and Audio Event Detection (AED). It supports over 100 languages for speech, singing, and music detection, offering both streaming and non-streaming capabilities, and outperforms existing VAD solutions in accuracy and efficiency.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 Shadowbroker | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To aggregate and visualize diverse, real-time, public global intelligence data in a single interface for analysts, researchers, and operators, with capabilities for AI-driven correlation discovery.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time multi-domain OSINT telemetry aggregation • Unified dark-ops map interface • 40+ toggleable data layers (SAR, Telegram OSINT, recon toolkit, cyber threat feeds)
📖 Summary: ShadowBroker is a real-time geospatial intelligence platform that aggregates data from over 60 live intelligence feeds into a unified dark-ops map interface. It visualizes aircraft, ships, satellites, conflict zones, CCTV, and geopolitical events, with options for AI analysis of unseen correlations.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
